verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is consumer GPU hardware, and service-style data retention and deletion controls fall outside that product category. The evidence mentions local, "fully private" AI execution on the PC, but that describes where processing runs, not a retention or deletion control. Nothing in the pack shows the product ships such a capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
